name: Five Little Children
competency: Counting down backwards, stepwise subtraction, linking action rhymes with mathematical removal
ncertStandard: Grade 1 Mathematics: Joyful Mathematics Chapter 3 (Five Little Children)
overview: A cheerful cartoon school bus travels along neighborhood stops. Children wave and step out one by one to the tune of the NCERT rhyme ('Five little children, raise your hand... Now, we are four!'). Children calculate remaining passengers down to 'none' (0).
learningOutcomes: Recite and apply sequential backwards counting (5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0)
Recognize 'none' as zero in daily life situations (school bus passengers stepping down at stops)

levels.name: Rhyme Bus (5 Children)
levels.description: NCERT original 5-verse rhyme with 1 child stepping out per stop

levels.name: Excursion Tour Bus (10 Children)
levels.description: Groups of 2 or 3 passengers stepping out at each stop
